meta.title: ACP Conversation Integration
meta.description: Use local ACP agents inside the normal DSH conversation, or delegate to native, continuable Cursor, Antigravity and Claude Code children. Resume a CLI session in this project and change CLI settings from the model menu. Keep the composer, timeline and stop controls; inspect tools and answer human interactions in place. The activity inbox surfaces pending decisions and interrupted turns and links back to DSH conversations. External CLI tools are not sandboxed by DSH.
